chunks: And it is narrated in some reports that they (peace be upon them) said:
Our servants and our caretakers are the most evil of Allah’s creation.
ai.seo_question: Who are considered the most evil of Allah's creation according to the Imams?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* illustrates the profound humility of the Imams, who describe their own servants as 'the worst of creation' to emphasize that proximity to divine authority does not confer inherent superiority. Shia scholars interpret this as a reminder that even the most devoted servants remain dependent on Allah’s mercy and are subject to His judgment, preventing spiritual arrogance. It underscores the concept that true status is derived from servitude to the Imam rather than worldly rank.
